item.title: How Would a Blockade of the Strait of Hormuz Work? Here Are Some Possibilities.
item.summary: The goal of the naval operation ordered by ordered by President Trump is to deny Iran the revenues it needs to fund its military, but there are many unknowns.

item.title: Iran’s Underground Air Force Base Was Hit Earlier in the War
item.summary: Satellite imagery shows impact craters at and near the tunnel entrances to aircraft shelters at Iran’s remote “Eagle 44” base.

item.title: Israel Launches New Attacks in Lebanon, Days Ahead of Rare Direct Talks
item.summary: Israel’s campaign targeting Hezbollah in Lebanon has been a source of tension in the U.S.-Iran cease-fire. Israeli and Lebanese officials plan to meet for rare talks in Washington this week.

item.title: In Pakistan Talks, Iran Saw a U.S. Trying to Dictate, Not Negotiate
item.summary: Iran sees American demands as reaching far beyond what the United States achieved in war. Tehran is gambling that it can withstand further bombardment more than Washington is willing to sustain economic chaos, experts say.

item.title: Netanyahu Says War With Iran Is ‘Not Yet Over’
item.summary: In a televised address, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of Israel sought to placate critics at home who say the war failed to achieve its goals.

item.title: Inside Tyre, a Lebanese City Bombarded by Israel
item.summary: In Tyre, a city on Lebanon’s coast, near-daily bombardments by Israel have killed and injured civilians, and left many searching for shelter.

item.title: Many Iranians Are Glad the Fighting Has Paused. Some Hard-liners Aren’t.
item.summary: The most fervent backers of the Islamic republic believe pausing the war for negotiations risks squandering what they see as a hard-won upper hand.

item.title: Iran Tries to Grasp Economic Devastation of War, and Find a Way Past It
item.summary: The vast scale of destruction wrought by U.S. and Israeli bombardment will make sanctions relief all the more vital to Iran’s government as it tries to negotiate a peace agreement.

item.title: Iran Has Been Consistent in War. Will It Be Consistent in Peace Talks?
item.summary: While President Trump’s war aims have changed by the moment, Iran has stuck to firm demands. The question is whether it will compromise in peace negotiations.

item.title: In New War With Israel, Hezbollah Defies Notion That It Was Crippled
item.summary: The Iran-backed Lebanese militant group surprised many with the intensity of its attacks on Israel in the current conflict.
